title: 129. God's Mercy - When We Put Jesus in First Place Everything Falls into Place!

reels.title: A simple test of faith: do you rejoice in another's conversion?
reels.hook: Test of faith: do you rejoice in another's conversion?
reels.why: From the parable he extracts a concrete question that every viewer can ask themselves. The conclusion "if I do not rejoice, that reveals what kind of person I am" is sharp and easily shareable.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: And then if I do not rejoice in that, brothers and sisters, that reveals what kind of person I am

cards.text: Test of faith: do you rejoice in another's conversion?
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Gospel of the lost sheep and the lost coin (Lk 15:1-10).
If I do not rejoice in that, that reveals what kind of person I am.
God's Mercy – When We Put Jesus in First Place Everything Falls into Place!

reels.title: Man can disappoint you, Jesus never
reels.hook: People will disappoint you. He never will.
reels.why: A short, well-rounded thought with a strong example of Judas and a closing sentence that is also the title of the episode. It is emotional and universal.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Jesus must be in first place and then everything will fall into place.

cards.text: People will disappoint you. He never will.
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
The host answers a letter from viewer Ivanka who testified about healing.
Man can let you down, disappoint you. Jesus will never disappoint you.
Judas was with Jesus for so long, and yet he betrayed him
God's Mercy – When We Put Jesus in First Place Everything Falls into Place!

reels.title: Always go to the last place – God will place you better
reels.hook: Degree, car, career – what do you boast of?
reels.why: Gives practical advice on humility ("you don't push yourself forward, you go to the last place") and lists concrete things people boast about. Easily applied to one's own life.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: You always go to the last place. You don't push yourself forward.

cards.text: Degree, car, career – what do you boast of?
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Epistle to the Philippians: Saint Paul on boasting in worldly achievements.
You always go to the last place. You don't push yourself forward.

reels.title: Why Jesus came to earth – and why no one is without sin
reels.hook: Why did Jesus come to earth at all?
reels.why: Begins with a direct question and provides a clear answer in several steps: the righteous before Jesus, the descent into the underworld and purgatory. Ends with the well-known sentence "I did not come to call the righteous".
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: There is no one today who is without sin.

cards.text: Why did Jesus come to earth at all?
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Gospel of the lost sheep (Lk 15:1-10).
Not that sinners be condemned, but that the righteous be saved.
There is no one today who is without sin.

reels.title: When you put Jesus in first place, your knowledge becomes God's weapon
reels.hook: Nothing you learned is in vain
reels.why: Connects the example of Saint Paul with the host's personal experience and ends with advice on patience. The message encourages everyone who spent years building a profession.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: when you put Jesus in first place then God uses that in the best way

cards.text: Nothing you learned is in vain
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
It is about Saint Paul, former Pharisee and persecutor of the Church.
That knowledge became God's weapon.
When you put Jesus in first place then God uses that in the best way.

reels.title: Testimony: narcolepsy since 7th grade, and now without symptoms
reels.hook: Suffering since 7th grade – now has no symptoms
reels.why: Personal story with concrete details (diagnosis, years, neurologist, Mk 9) and a strong ending that gives glory to God, and not to man.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: I do not honor and I do not glorify Vladimir but Jesus Christ the Father and the Holy Spirit.

cards.text: Suffering since 7th grade – now has no symptoms

The host reads a letter from viewer Ivanka who fasts and prays with Ora et Labora.

reels.title: Croat, Catholic, degree – Saint Paul says: that is boasting in the flesh
reels.hook: Croat, Catholic, degree – reason for pride?
reels.why: Provocatively applies Paul's thought to Croatian identity and career. The point that blamelessness was an obstacle to receiving Jesus surprises.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: But all of that together was actually an obstacle to receiving Jesus.

cards.text: Croat, Catholic, degree – reason for pride?
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Epistle to the Philippians, where Saint Paul writes: »We are the circumcision.«
Saint Paul says that that is boasting in the flesh.
